                                                              大新銀行集團有限公司 2019年年報
     主席報告書
     CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT




     本集團之業務在經歷大致平穩的上半年後，於下                       After a reasonable first half of the year, our business was impacted
     半年受到經營環境轉差，撥備增加及淨息差受壓                       by the slower business conditions in the second half, as well as
     影響。下半年較業績疲弱導致年內股東應佔溢利                       increased provisions and pressure on net interest margin. The weaker
     下降9.7%至22億4千萬港元。                            second half performance led to a reduction in profit attributable to
                                                 shareholders of 9.7% to HK$2,240 million for the year.


     本集團業務的營運表現略遜去年，營運收入較                        The operating performance of our business was slightly weaker than
     2018年下跌6%。下半年的淨利息收入及服務費                     the prior year, with operating income down 6% compared with 2018.
     收入基本持平，而交易收入相比上半年則大幅改                       Both net interest income and fee income were broadly flat in the
     善，主要由於香港利率較高（儘管遠低於2018年）                    second half, whilst trading income improved considerably half on half,
     所致。                                         mainly due to the higher interest rates in Hong Kong, although much
                                                 lower than in 2018.


     營商環境困難，尤其是本集團的商業銀行業務，                       Business conditions were difficult, particularly in our commercial
     香港及澳門市場的客戶貸款需求低迷，而內地市                       banking operation, with subdued loan demand amongst our customers
     場相關客戶的需求則仍然較為強勁。本集團的零                       in the Hong Kong and Macau markets, whilst demand remained
     售銀行業務表現略好，特別是香港住宅按揭市場                       somewhat stronger amongst customers related to the Mainland
     交易量增長，儘管下半年出現社會動盪，物業交                       market. Our retail banking business performed slightly better, with
     易及價格總體保持良好。然而，鑑於淨息差持續                       volumes growing particularly in the Hong Kong residential mortgage

     經歷2019年下半年疲弱之市況後，本集團希望                      After a weak second half in 2019, we were hoping to see some

     港，中國內地及澳門等本集團其他主要市場的經                       be, but it is very clear that the economy has weakened further not only

     或會被全球經濟疲弱所拖累。                               and Macau, with the recovery of these key markets likely delayed by a
                                                 weakening global economy.

     誠付出。                                        dedication of our staff, who have responded positively to the difficult
                                                 conditions that are being faced.

     繼續對業務風險持非常審慎態度，這不僅是對業                       we see a more stable picture, we continue to be very cautious about
     務增長，亦是本集團對員工及客戶而言。就此，                       risks in our business — not only to our business growth, but also to
     本集團上個月推出若干支援方案，透過各種措施                       our staff and customers. In this regard, last month we announced a

事會全體成員須深入審議後方可作出該等委任。     new directors to sub-committees of the Board or to the management
                          of the Company, and require that such appointments are made after
                          deliberation by the full Board.

     本集團之薪酬政策                                       The Group’s Remuneration Policy

     本集團之薪酬政策旨在為僱員維持與市場條件相                          The Group’s policy on remuneration is to maintain fair and competitive
     若、公平且具競爭力之薪酬配套，並根據業務需                          packages for its employees, which are commensurate with market
     要、專業才能、個人之素質，且參照行業慣例與                          terms, and are based on business needs, expertise and quality of
     監管指引而訂立。                                       the individuals, and with proper reference to industry practice and
                                                    regulatory guidelines.


     就釐定支付予董事會成員之袍金水平而言，將會                          For determining the level of fees paid to members of the Board of
     考慮市場的袍金水平及各董事之工作量及其須作                          Directors, market rates and factors such as each director’s workload
     出之承擔等因素。釐定執行董事薪酬待遇之考慮                          and required commitment will be taken into account. The following
     因素如下：                                          factors are considered when determining the remuneration packages
                                                    of EDs:


     －     業務需要及表現                                  –     Business needs and performance


     －     整體經濟及商業情況                                –     The economy and business conditions in general


     －     個別對本集團之貢獻                                –     Each individual’s contributions to the Group


     －     風險相關之表現                                  –     Risk related performance


     －     參考與個人職責相符之市場薪酬水平                         –     Reference to market pay level commensurate with the
                                                          individual’s responsibility


     －     遵行監管指引                                   –     Consideration of regulatory guidelines


     －     留任之考慮因素及個別之潛能                            –     Retention considerations and each individual’s potential


     於考慮過程中，董事不可參與有關其本人薪酬之                          During the process of consideration, no individual director will be
     決定。                                            involved in decisions relating to his/her own remuneration.

內部監控                        Internal Controls

董事會授權管理層負責制訂及維持健全之內部監       The Board has delegated to management the responsibility to
控制度。內部監控制度擬通過管理及營運監控、       develop and maintain a sound internal control system. The internal
風險管理制度架構之運作，使董事會可監察本集       control system, operating through a framework of management and
團之業務表現及財務狀況、監控及調節風險、採       operational controls, and risk management systems, is intended to
納健全之業務守則、合理確證對欺詐及誤差之監       allow the Board to monitor the Group’s business performance and
控、確保遵守適用法例及規則，以及對管理人員       financial positions, to control and adjust risk exposures, to adopt
作出監察及提供指引，以達成本公司之目標。然       sound business practices, to obtain reasonable assurance on controls
而，本集團之內部監控程序僅可對重大誤差、損       against fraud and errors, to ensure compliance with applicable laws
失或欺詐提供合理而非絕對之保證。            and regulations, and to exercise oversight on and provide guidance
                            to management in achieving the Company’s objectives. However, it
                            should be recognized that the Group’s internal control procedures
                            can only provide reasonable, not absolute, assurance against material
                            errors, losses or fraud.

2.2 綜合財務報表                 2.2 Consolidation

12月31日止之財務報表。              of the Company and all its subsidiaries made up to 31 December.


     （甲）附屬公司                    (a)    Subsidiaries

     附屬公司是本集團可控制之實體（包括結構        A subsidiary is an entity (including a structured entity) over which
     性實體）。本集團可控制該實體是指當本集        the Group has control. The Group controls an entity when the
     團透過參與該實體而面對或有權獲取可變的        Group is exposed to, or has rights to, variable returns from its
     回報，且有能力藉着對該實體之權力影響該        involvement with the entity and has the ability to affect those
     等回報。自控制權轉移予本集團當日起附屬        returns through its power over the entity. Subsidiaries are
     公司作綜合計算，並由該控制權終止之日起        consolidated from the date on which control is transferred to
     不再綜合計算。                    the Group. They are deconsolidated from the date that control
                                ceases.


     本集團以收購會計法為本集團之業務合併列        The acquisition method of accounting is used to account
     賬。收購一間附屬公司所付出之代價為已轉        for business combinations by the Group. The consideration
     移資產、承擔之負債及本集團發行之權益之        transferred for the acquisition of a subsidiary is the fair values
     公平值。所付出代價包括任何或然代價安排        of the assets transferred, the liabilities incurred and the equity
     之資產或負債之公平值。收購相關之費用於        interests issued by the Group. The consideration transferred
     產生時支銷。在業務合併過程中取得所收購        includes the fair value of any asset or liability resulting from
     可被認明資產及承擔之負債及或然負債，均        a contingent consideration arrangement. Acquisition-related
     於收購當日按其公平值作出初始計量。本集        costs are expensed as incurred. Identifiable assets acquired
     團根據逐項收購基準按公平值或按沒控制權        and liabilities and contingent liabilities assumed in a business
     股東應佔被收購者資產淨值之比例確認任何        combination are measured initially at their fair values at the
     被收購者之沒控制權股東權益。             acquisition date. On an acquisition-by-acquisition basis,
                                the Group recognises any non-controlling interest in the
                                acquiree either at fair value or at the non-controlling interest’s
                                proportionate share of the acquiree’s net assets.


     所付出之代價、任何沒控制權股東於被收購        The excess of the consideration transferred, the amount of any
     者權益以及在收購日期於被收購者權益之公        non-controlling interest in the acquiree and the acquisition-date

                         internal credit grading.

3.2.3 減輕風險及控制額度之政策       3.2.3 Risk limit control and mitigation policies

本集團已就個別借款人或交易對手集團、行業或    The Group has an established framework to manage and control
國家設定框架管理及控制過度集中之風險。根據    concentrations risk with respect to individual borrower or counterparty
借款人或交易對手集團、行業或國家之既定風險    group, industry or country. Exposure limits by borrower or counterparty

      3.3 市場風險                                                  3.3 Market risk

      市場風險乃指由市場上利率及價格變化而引致對                                     Market risk is the risk of losses in assets, liabilities and off-balance
      資產、負債及資產負債表外持倉之虧損風險。                                      sheet positions arising from movements in market rates and prices.


      各類交易之市場風險均由董事會、風險管理及合                                     Market risk exposure for different types of transactions is managed
      規委員會及財資及投資風險委員會按董事會授予                                     within various risk limits and guidelines approved by the Board, the
      之權力所核准之各項風險限額及指引內處理。風                                     RMCC and the TIRC under the authority delegated from the Board.
      險限額按組合層面以及各產品及不同風險類別設                                     Risk limits are set at the portfolio level as well as by products and
      定。該等限額綜合包含了名義金額、止蝕限額、                                     by different types of risks. The risk limits comprise a combination
      敏感性及運用市場風險數值（「市場風險數值」）之                                   of notional, stop-loss, sensitivity and value-at-risk (“VaR”) controls.
      監控。所有涉及市場風險的買賣持倉需要每日按                                     All trading positions are subject to daily mark-to-market valuation.
      市值入賬。集團風險部之風險管理及監控部（「風                                    The Risk Management and Control Department (“RMCD”) within the
      險管理及監控部」）乃一個獨立之風險管理及控制                                    GRD, as an independent risk management and control unit, identifies,
      部門，負責比較風險和已審批限額，以識別、計                                     measures, monitors and controls the risk exposures against approved
      量、監控及管理該等風險及提議具體行動去確保                                     limits and initiates specific actions to ensure positions are managed
      持倉被限制在可接受水平內。任何不符合限額情                                     within an acceptable level. Any exceptions have to be reviewed and
      況均須依據有關政策及程序經合適管理層－財資                                     sanctioned by the appropriate level of management of TIRC, RMCC or
      及投資風險委員會，風險管理及合規委員會或董                                     the Board as stipulated in the relevant policies and procedures.
      事會審查及批准。

12. 董事酬金（續）                      12. DIRECTORS’ EMOLUMENTS (Continued)
註：                               Note:


1.   以股份作為基礎報酬之支付包括於年度內就已行       1.      Share-based compensation payment includes both equity-settled and
     使認股權以股權及已註銷認股權以現金支付之以               cash-settled share based payment on the share options exercised or
     股份作為基礎之支付。以股權支付之以股份作為               cancelled during the year. For equity-settled share based compensations,
     基礎支付之報酬，其代表本集團就認股權被行使               it represents the cost borne by the Group recognised on the exercise of
     時確認承擔的支出。而以現金支付之以股份作為               the share options while for cash-settled share based compensation, it
     基礎支付之報酬，則代表行使價與認股權被註銷               represents the cash payment, being the difference between the exercise

於2019年12月31日，本集團在重慶銀行之投資之   At 31 December 2019, the fair value of the Group’s investment in
公平值已低於賬面值大約6年。為此，本集團持續      BOCQ had been below the carrying amount for approximately 6
對在重慶銀行之投資之賬面值進行減值測試以評       years. On this basis, the Group continues to perform an impairment
估可收回金額。                     test on the carrying amount of the investment in BOCQ to assess the
                            recoverable amount.


減值測試比對以計算使用價值（「使用價值」）而釐     The impairment test is performed by comparing the recoverable
定之重慶銀行可收回金額和該投資之賬面值。使       amount of BOCQ, determined by a value in use (“VIU”) calculation,
用價值乃按照管理層估量之重慶銀行盈利和未來       with the carrying amount of the investment. The VIU calculation uses
將派股息，及經考慮重慶銀行中期和長期之增長       discounted cash flow projections based on management’s estimates of
及資產淨值後之預期未來的可能脫手價值，應用       BOCQ’s earnings and dividends to be paid in future, and the estimated
貼現現金流量預測計算。應用於使用價值計算之       probable exit value in future after considering the growth of BOCQ and
貼現率乃參考可於公開市場獲取之重慶銀行股本       its net asset value for the medium and longer term. The discount rate
成本而估算。                      applied to the VIU calculation was estimated with reference to BOCQ’s
                            cost of equity, which is publicly available in the market.

總體淨額結算安排                    Master netting arrangements

本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結算安       To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規定，一旦       arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之未完成交易       agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all outstanding
均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼合按淨額結算。       transactions with the counterparty will be terminated and all amounts
如非發生違約事件，所有與對手之交易會以總額       outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except for the event of
結算及一般不會在財務狀況表中對銷資產及負債。      default, all outstanding transactions with the counterparty are settled
                            on a gross basis and generally do not result in offsetting the assets
                            and liabilities in the statement of financial position.

      46. 報告期後之不調整事項                                            46. NON-ADJUSTING EVENT AFTER THE REPORTING
                                                                    PERIOD
      自2020年1月起在中國境內爆發及擴散，並蔓延                                   The outbreak and spread of the coronavirus disease across Mainland
      至國外之新型冠狀病毒已擾亂多國之商業和經濟                                     China and beyond since January 2020 has caused disruption to
      活動，及引致全球經濟的不確定性。                                          business and economic activities, and uncertainty to the global
                                                                economy.
